spans.s:
पल् पल्, cl. 1. P. पलति, पलितुम्, to
go, move; cl. 10. पालयति, -यितुम्, see
rt. 3. पा; [cf. Gr. πάλλω, παλμό-ς, πάλο-ς,
πα-λάσσω, παλ-ύν-ω; Lat. pello, poll-en, pul-vi-s.]

पल्ल् पल्ल् [cf. rt. पल्], cl. 1. P. पल्लति,
पल्लितुम्, to go, move.
पाल् पाल्. See Caus. of rt. 3. पा.
पल, अस्, m. = पाल (Gaṇa Jvalādi to Pāṇ.

); = पलाल, straw; (अम्), n. a particular
weight (= 4 Karṣas = (1/100) of a Tulā); a particular
measure of fluids; a particular measure of time (=
विघटिका); flesh, meat; [cf. Lat. palea; Angl.
Sax. flesc, flœsc, flec; Old Germ. fleisk; French
paille; Hib. feol, feoile, ‘flesh.’]
—पल-क्षार,
अस्, m. ‘flesh-fluid,’ blood.
—पल-गण्ड, अस्, m. a
mason, bricklayer, plasterer.
—पलङ्-कर, अस्, m.
‘flesh-maker,’ gall, bile.
—पलङ्-कष, अस्, m.
‘flesh-hurter,’ a Rākṣasa, imp, goblin; bdellium;
a species of bdellium (= कण-गुग्गुलु); (आ), f.,
N. of various plants (= गो-क्षुरक, Asteracantha
[]
Longifolia; = क्षुद्र-गोक्षुरक; = किंशुक,
Butea Frondosa; = मुण्डीरी, a species of climbing
plant; = रास्न; = महा-श्रावणी, bdellium); = लाक्-
षा, cochineal; a fly.
—पल-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond
of meat,’ a Rākṣasa; a raven.
—पल-भा or पल-
विभा, f. the equinoctial shadow at midday, the
midday shadow of a gnomon when the sun is in the
equinoctial points (= विष्णुवत्-प्रभा).
—पलाग्नि
(˚ल-अग्˚), इस्, m. ‘flesh-fire,’ bile, the bilious humor.
—पलाद (˚ल-अद), अस्, m. ‘flesh-eater,’ a Rāk-
ṣasa; (आ), f. a Rākṣasī.
—पलादन (˚ल-अद्˚),
अस्, or 1. पलाश (˚ल-आश्˚), अस्, or 1. पलाशिन्
(˚ल-आश्˚), ई, m. ‘flesh-eater,’ a Rākṣasa.
पल्ल, अस्, m. a large granary, barn.

पाल, अस्, m. a guard, guardian, protector,
nourisher, keeper; a herdsman; a protector of the
earth, a prince; a spitting-pot, spittoon; N. of a
Nāga of the race of Vāsuki; of a prince; (ई), f. a
[]
herdsman's wife; [cf. पालि.]
—पाल-कवि-राज, अस्,
m., N. of a poet (also called Śrī-pāla-kavi-rāja).
—पाल-काव्य, अम्, n. ‘the poem of Pāla,’ N. of a
work.
—पाल-घ्न, अस्, m. a mushroom.
—पाल-
बणिज्, क्, m. = कन्या-पाल; (a wrong form for
पान-बणिज्.)
—पाली-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a par-
ticular religious observance.

पलद, अस्, m., Ved. a particular material for
building, (perhaps) bundles of straw or reeds used
for roofing and wainscoting; (ई), f., N. of a village.

पलल, अस्, m. a Rākṣasa; ground sesamum
seeds, a kind of sweetmeat made of ground sesamum
and sugar; mud, mire, clay; = पल, flesh, meat;
[cf. पल्वल; Gr. πηλό-ς, πήλ-ινο-ς,
προ-πηλακ-ίζω; Lat. păl-ū(d)s, palus-tri-s; Hib. poll, ‘mire,
dirt.’]
—पलल-ज्वर, अस्, m. gall, bile; [cf. प-
लाग्नि, पलङ्-कर.]
—पलल-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond
of flesh,’ a raven (= पल-प्रिय).
—पललाशय
(˚ल-आश्˚), अस्, m. ‘flesh-receptacle,’ swelled neck,
goitre.

पलाल पलाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be
fr. rt. पल्), straw; the stalk of the Sorghum,
[]
Indian millet; (अस्), m., Ved., N. of a demon (asso-
ciated with Anu-palāla and considered dangerous to
children); (आ), f., N. of one of the seven Mātṛs
of Skanda; (ई), f. straw.
—पलाल-दोहद, अस्, m.
‘longing for straw,’ the mango tree (the fruit of
which is sometimes ripened in straw).

पालल पालल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पलल), made
of powdered sesamum seed.

पालाल पालाल, अस्, ई, अम् (probably incor-
rectly for पाल्वल), living in a marsh.

पलिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp. after
a numeral), weighing or containing so many Palas.

पल्लिका, f. a village, station [cf. आभीर-प्˚]; a
small house-lizard.

पालिका, f. the tip of the ear; the sharp edge of
a cutting instrument; a sort of ladle or knife for
skimming milk, curds, &c.; a cheese or butter
knife.

पलक्या पलक्या, f. a kind of vegetable
(= पालङ्क्य).

पालक्या पालक्या, f. the plant Beta Ben-
galensis.

पलक्ष पलक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (a secondary
form of बलक्ष), Ved. white.

पलङ्कट पलङ्कट, अस्, आ, अम्, shy, bashful,
timid.

पलव पलव, अस्, m. (said to be connected
with rt. पल्, probably for प्लव fr. rt. प्लु), a snare
or basket of wicker-work for catching fish.

पलाव पलाव, अस्, m., Ved. chaff, husks;
[cf. Lat. palea.]

1. पल्लव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a sprout, shoot, twig,
sprig, spray, (literally and as a metaphorical expression
for the fingers, toes, and lips; cf. कर-प्˚, ओष्ठ-
प्˚); a bud, blossom; a blade of grass; the extre-
mity of a robe, the loose end of a garment or scarf;
spreading, expansion; epithet of a particular position
of the hands in dancing; the red dye called अ-लक्त;
love, affection; a bracelet, armlet; unsteadiness
moral or physical (?); strength, power (?); a wood (?);
(अस्), m. a libertine, catamite; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people.
—पल्लवग्राहि-ता, f. the picking up of
twigs or straws, the dealing with trifles; superficial
or diffusive knowledge.
—पल्लव-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ,
putting forth young shoots, sprouting in all directions;
twig-picking, straw-gathering; laying hold of trifles;
diffusive; superficial; (ई), m., scil. दोष, the fault
of prolixity or diffusiveness or of mere superficial
knowledge.
—पल्लव-द्रु, उस्, m. the Aśoka tree.
—पल्लव-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of young
shoots or twigs.
—पल्लवाङ्कुर (˚व-अङ्˚), अस्, m.
a leaf-bud.
—पल्लवाद (˚व-अद), अस्, m. ‘eating
young shoots,’ a deer.
—पल्लवाधार (˚व-आध्˚),
अस्, m. ‘receptacle or support of twigs,’ a branch.
—पल्लवापीडित (˚व-आप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, bud-laden,
loaded with buds.
—पल्लवास्त्र (˚व-अस्˚), अस्, m.
‘having blossoms for missiles,’ an epithet of the
god of love.

2. पल्लव, Nom. P. पल्लवति, पल्लवितुम्, to
put forth young shoots, sprout, bud.

पाल्लवा पाल्लवा, f. (fr. पल्लव), scil. क्रीडा,
a game played with twigs.

पलस पलस, अस्, m. = पनस, the bread
fruit tree.

पलाश 2. पलाश, अम्, n. (for 1. see under
पल, rt. पल्, p. 556, col. 2), a leaf, petal, foliage;
the blossom of the tree Butea Frondosa; (अस्),
m. Butea Frondosa; Curcuma Zedoaria; a N. of
ancient Behar or Magadha; (ई), f. cochineal; a
species of climbing plant (= पत्त्र-वल्ली, पर्ण-
वल्ली, पलाशिका); (अस्, आ, अम्), green; unfeeling,
unmerciful, cruel; (at the end of a comp.) see Gaṇa
to Pāṇ.

.
—पलाश-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf
of the Butea Frondosa; a single leaf; (अस्), m., N.
of a Nāga.
—पलाश-पर्णी, f. Physalis Flexuosa
(= अश्व-गन्धा).
—पलाश-शातन, अस्, m. an
instrument for lopping foliage.
—पलाशाख्य (˚श-
आख्˚), अस्, m. = नाडी-हिङ्गु, q. v.; Asa Fœtida.
—पलाशान्ता (˚श-अन्˚) or पलाशाम्भा, f. =
गन्ध-पत्त्र, q. v.

पालाश पालाश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पलाश), com-
ing from or belonging to the tree Butea Frondosa,
made of the wood of the Butea Frondosa; green;
(अस्), m. green (the colour).
—पालाश-खण्ड and
पालाश-षण्ड, अस्, m. an epithet of Magadha (a
country in India, the western part of Behar).

पलस्ति पलस्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (according
to Sāy.) = पलित, grey-haired.

पलाङ्ग पलाङ्ग, अस्, m. Delphinus Gange-
ticus; (perhaps an error for चपलाङ्ग.)

पलाण्डु पलाण्डु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be
fr. rt. पल्), an onion.
—पलाण्डु-भक्षित, अस्,
आ or ई, अम्, one who has eaten onions.

पलाप पलाप, अस्, m. a halter; an ele-
phant's temples.

पलापहा पलापहा, f. a kind of collyrium
(= कुलत्था; perhaps only an error for प्र-
लाप-हा).

पलाय पलाय (fr. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पला =
परा), cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) पलायते (-ति), -यितुम्,
to flee, run away, make off, take to one's heels,
scamper off; to escape; to cease, die away, sink
into oblivion.

पलायक, अस्, आ, or इका (?), अम्, fleeing, flying,
taking to flight; a fugitive, runaway, deserter.
पलायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fleeing, running away.

पालयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, guarding, protecting,
cherishing.

पलायन, अम्, n. fleeing, running away, flight,
escape; a saddle (= पल्ययन, पर्याण).
—प-
लायन-परायण, अस्, आ, अम्, occupied in flight,
fugitive.
—पलायन-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, thinking
of flight.
—पलायन-विषय, अस्, आ, अम्, having
flight for an object, bent on flight.

पलायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fleeing, flying away,
taking to flight.

पलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, run away, fled,
retreated; defeated.

पलायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fleeing, flying, running away,
taking to flight.

पलाशक, अस्, m. Butea Frondosa; Curcuma
Zedoaria (= शटी); N. of a place; (इका), f. a species
of climbing plant (= पलाशी).

2. पलाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see under पल, rt.
पल्), leafy, covered with foliage, having luxuriant
foliage; (ई), m. a tree; a species of plant (= क्षीर-
वृक्ष); N. of a city or a village (said to be the
modern Plassey); (इनी), f., N. of a river issuing from
the Śukti-mat.
पलिक्नी पलिक्नी, f. See पलित below.

पलिघ पलिघ, अस्, m. a water-pot, pitcher,
glass water-vessel; a wall, rampart; the gate-way of
a building; an iron club or one studded with iron
(= परिघ).

पलित पलित, अस्, पलिक्नी, अम् (said to be
fr. rt. फल् with substitution of प् for फ्; a doubtful
fem. form पलिता is also given), grey, grey-haired,
hoary, old, aged; (अस्), m., N. of a mouse in Mahā-
bh. Śānti-p. 4933; (पलिक्नी), f. a cow for the first
time with calf; (अम्), n. grey hair; a tuft of hair
(= केश-पाश); much or ornamented hair; mud,
mire; heat, burning; benzoin; [cf. Gr. πελ-ὀ-ς,
πελ-ιό-ς, πελ-λό-ς, πελιδνό-ς, παλ-ιό-ς: Lat. pall-
e-o, pall-idu-s, pallu-s: Old Germ. falo (fal-w-
er): Angl. Sax. fealo, falu, fealwe, falewe: Slav.
plavŭ, ‘white:’ Lith. pàl-va-s, ‘fallow;’ pī1l-ka-s,
‘ash-coloured.’]
—पलितङ्-करण, अस्, ई, अम्, ren-
dering grey.
—पलितम्-भविष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, or
पलितम्-भावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming grey.

पालित, अस्, आ, अम्, guarded, protected, cherished,
nourished; (अस्), m. a species of tree (= शाखोट);
N. of a son of Parā-jit (or Parā-vṛt); (आ), f., N. of
one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
पलितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having grey hair, grey-haired.
पलियोग पलि-योग, अस्, m. = परि-योग.

पलीजक पलीजक, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a
demon.

पल्पूल् पल्पूल् (considered by some as
a reduplicated form of rt. पल्), cl.
10. P. पल्पूलयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to wash in lye
or water impregnated with alkaline salt; to wash,
cleanse; to tan.

पल्पूलन, अम्, n., Ved. lye, water impregnated
with alkaline salt.

पल्पूलित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. curried, tanned;
washed (in lye).

पल्य पल्य, अम्, n. (perhaps fr. पल), a
sack for corn (probably containing a certain measure,
Ved.); a particular high number.

पाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected or guarded, to
be cherished; being under (any one's) protection or
guardianship; to be observed or kept, to be main-
tained.

पल्यङ्क पल्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. = पर्य्-अङ्क, a
bed, couch, bedstead; a cloth thrown round the loins
while sitting (= पर्य्-अस्ति, पर्यस्तिका).

पल्यङ्ग् पल्य्-अङ्ग् (for पर्य्-अङ्ग्), Caus. P.
[]
-अङ्गयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to go round, stir
round: Pass. -अङ्ग्यते, to turn round, revolve.

पल्यय् पल्य्-अय् (fr. अय् = rt. 5. इ with पलि
= परि), cl. 1. A. -अयते, &c., Ved. to go round.

पल्य्-अयन, अम्, n. = पर्याण, a saddle, pack-
saddle; a rein, bridle.

पल्युल् पल्युल् and पल्यूल् (various
readings for पल्पूल्, q. v.), cl. 10.
P. पल्युलयति, पल्यूलयति, -यितुम्, to wash,
&c.; to cut, cut off (in this sense perhaps for
परि-लू).

पल्लवक, अस्, m. a libertine, gallant, the paramour
of a harlot; a catamite; a species of fish, Cyprinus
Denticulatus; (इका), f., N. of a female attendant.

पल्लवय, Nom. P. पल्लवयति, -यितुम्, to
put forth young shoots, sprout; to cause to sprout,
to make diffuse or prolix (according to a Scholiast
= विस्तारय).

पल्लविक, अस्, m. a libertine, gallant; a catamite;
a species of fish, Cyprinus Denticulatus.

पल्लवित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprouting, having young
shoots; spread, extended; dyed red with lac, pos-
sessing the red dye; (अस्), m. the red dye of the
lac insect.

पल्लविन्, ई, इनी, इ, sprouting, having young shoots;
(ई), m. a tree.

पल्लि, इस्, or ई, f. a small village, especially a settle-
ment of wild tribes; a hut, house; any number of
houses, a station; a city (or rather an affix to words
forming the name of towns; it is especially used in
the Dekhan as in Trichinopoly = Triśira-pallī, &c.);
a small house-lizard; a creeping plant.
पल्लि पल्लि. See under rt. पल्ल् above.

पालि पालि, इस्, f. (fr. Caus. of rt. 3. पा?;
[]
said to be fr. rt. पल्), the tip of the ear; an edge,
margin; a boundary, limit; the sharp side of any-
thing, the sharp edge or point of a sword or any
cutting instrument; a line, row, range; a raised
bank, dike, causeway, bridge; the lap, bosom; the
hip, haunch; a mark, spot, stain; a particular mea-
sure of capacity (= प्रस्थ); a louse; a woman
with a beard; prescribed food, maintenance of a
scholar during the period of his studies by his teacher;
praise, eulogium; a circumference; (ई), f. an edge,
margin; the sharp edge of a sword; a line, row,
range; a woman with a beard; a louse; a pot,
boiler; an oblong pond; a causeway, bridge.
—पा-
लिं-हिर, अस्, m. a kind of snake, (perhaps a
wrong reading for पालिं-हर, seizing by the tip
of the ear.)

पल्लिवाह पल्लिवाह, अस्, m. a species of
grass.

पल्वल पल्वल, अस्, m. (connected with प-
लित; said to be fr. rt. पल्), a small tank, pond, pool;
[cf. Gr. πηλό-ς, πήλ-ινο-ς, προ-πηλακ-ίζω; Lat. pal-
u(d)-s, palus-tri-s; perhaps Angl. Sax. pol, ‘a pool.’]
—पल्वल-तीर, अम्, n. the bank or margin of a
pool.
—पल्वल-पङ्क, अस्, m. the mud of a
pool.
—पल्वलावास (˚ल-आव्˚), अस्, m. ‘living in
ponds,’ a tortoise.

पाल्वल पाल्वल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पल्वल),
coming from a tank or pool.
पल्वल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. marshy, boggy.

पालक, अस्, इका, अम्, guarding, protecting, nourish-
ing; (अस्), m. a guardian, protector, cherisher,
nourisher; a foster-father; a prince, ruler, sovereign;
a horse-keeper, a groom; one who maintains or
observes; N. of several princes; a species of plant
with a poisonous bulb, Plumbago Zeylanica; a
horse.
—पालक-गोत्र, अम्, n. the family or tribe
of one's adoptive parents.
—पालकाख्या (˚क-
आख्˚), f., N. of the mother of Dhanvantari.

पालक्क पालक्क, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N.
of a country.

पालन, अस्, ई, अम्, the act of protecting, guarding,
fostering, nourishing, cherishing; (अम्), n. guarding,
providing with a guardian, protecting, protection,
preserving, cherishing, fostering, nourishing; main-
taining, keeping, observing; the milk of a cow that
has recently calved.

पालनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or protected,
to be cherished or nourished; fit to be preserved or
maintained; to be observed or respected.

पालयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, protecting, cherishing; a
protector, guardian.

पालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, protecting, guarding, cherishing,
nourishing; (ई), m., N. of a son of Pṛthu.

पालकाप्य पालकाप्य, अस्, m., N. of an
ancient sage or Muni; a form of the divine physician
Dhanvantari.

पालङ्क पालङ्क, अस्, m. the olibanum tree,
Boswellia Thurifera; a species of beet-root, Beta
Bengalensis; a hawk; (ई), f. the resin of the
olibanum tree, incense.

पालङ्क्य, अस्, आ, m. f. gum olibanum, incense;
(अम्, आ), n. f. the plant Beta Bengalensis.

पालङ्गिन् पालङ्गिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a
school called after a disciple of Vaiśampāyana.
पालवी पालवी, f. a kind of vessel.

पालहरि पालहरि, इस्, m. (probably a patro-
nymic fr. पलहर), N. of a man.

पालागल पालागल, अस्, m., Ved. a runner,
messenger; (according to others) a bearer of false
tidings; (ई), f. the fourth and least respected wife
of a prince.

पालित्य पालित्य, अम्, n. (fr. पलित), grey-
ness (of age), hoariness.

पालिन्द पालिन्द, अस्, m. incense; a species
of jasmine, Jasminum Pubescens; (ई), f. a species of
creeper, Ichnocarpus Frutescens; = पालिन्धी.

पालिन्धी पालिन्धी, f. a species of Ipomœa
with dark blossoms.
